identity.name: Blueprint

identity.positioning: Solution-architecture register — methodology product, not publication

primary.name: Blueprint Slate
primary.usage: Default-theme brand color. hsl(225, 60%, 45%). Matches project-tokens.css [data-theme=slate] --brand-500.

accent.name: Blueprint Slate
accent.usage: Single-accent brand — matches primary in default theme.

attributes.description: Role-named subjects (the methodology / the CLI / the stamper) act on the page; reader is observer, not actor
attributes.example: The methodology declares variants in blueprint.yml. The stamper writes the chrome at scaffold time.

attributes.description: Settled facts are declarative; proposals are named as proposals; recommended paths are named as recommended
attributes.example: Wedge 1 is the proposed closure for Gap 1. The recommended path is npx @blueprint/cli init.

attributes.description: Solution Architecture register — diagram-friendly, deliberate, no ambiguity in role naming
attributes.example: Brownfield initiatives run a current-state diagnose stage before prescription.

attributes.description: Same voice principles across CLI / docs / portal but length and explanatory depth tune to audience
attributes.example: CLI: 'Variant: brownfield.' Docs: 'The variant declaration constrains which stages apply.'

attributes.description: Success messages state the result, not the celebration; no 'great' / 'awesome' / 'perfect'

antiPatterns.suggestion: Replace with role-subject. 'The methodology declares' / 'The CLI asks' / 'The stamper writes'.
Use role-name as subject. Brand-name labels the system, not the verbs. 'The methodology declares' / 'The CLI asks'.
Replace with grounded markers. 'The proposed' / 'The recommended' / 'For X, the path is' / 'structurally closes' / 'defers to'.
Inherits operator's published-prose anti-patterns. Say the actual thing.
Stating the result IS the celebration. Drop the praise word.

structuralPatterns.name: role-subject-opening
structuralPatterns.description: Open declarative sentences with the role-name subject performing the action
structuralPatterns.example: The methodology declares variants. The CLI asks three questions at init.

structuralPatterns.name: grounded-proposal-naming
structuralPatterns.description: When stating a proposal, name it as a proposal explicitly
structuralPatterns.example: Wedge 1 is the proposed closure for Gap 1.

structuralPatterns.name: audience-tuned-length
structuralPatterns.description: Match length and depth to the surface — terse for CLI, methodical for docs, neutral for portal

structuralPatterns.name: understated-success
structuralPatterns.description: Success messages state results without celebration language

examples.good: The methodology runs Stage 1 (research) before Stage 2 (prescription). For brownfield variants, Stage 1 includes a current-state diagnose. For greenfield variants, the diagnose stage is skipped.
examples.bad: Blueprint can typically be used to do research before prescription, depending on whether you have an existing codebase. You might run a diagnose first if it seems useful.
Great job! The stamp was successfully completed and 8 files were written without any conflicts.

examples.good: Audit-gap 2 closed via the theme registry. L0 is no longer borrowed; the methodology declares its own 4-theme palette.
examples.bad: Blueprint may have closed the borrowed-palette issue by implementing a multi-theme system. Depending on adoption, this should help with the L0 layer.

templates.description: OG image for methodology releases, ADRs, prescription announcements

creative.basePrompt:
BRAND: Blueprint — production-quality methodology + scaffolding for initiative-scoped agent-assisted work.
AESTHETIC: Solution Architecture register. Methodology product, not publication. Light surface, deliberate, diagram-friendly.

VISUAL LANGUAGE:
- Architectural blueprints, isometric grids, technical drawings
- Abstract scaffold patterns, modular grid systems, structural lines
- Stage-pipeline diagrams (subtle), atomic-design level visualizations
- Light/warm or cool near-white backgrounds with brand-color accent
- Clean lines, no decoration, no flourish

conceptMap.blueprint: architectural blueprint grid pattern, technical drawing aesthetic
conceptMap.scaffold: modular grid scaffold, structural framework lines
conceptMap.pipeline: stage-pipeline diagram, sequential blocks, methodology flow
conceptMap.layer: atomic-design level stack, L0-L5 horizontal bands
